text:
Emma L: Heads-up — Nimbus Secure wants to co-announce a marketplace listing + SI integration next month. Need a single playbook covering SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and KMS/BYO for secrets migration. Can we sync on scope and owners? @Raj Patel @Sarah O'Connor

Raj Patel: +1. Proposed scope: (1) SSO SAML metadata exchange and test matrix, (2) SCIM provisioning mapping and group/entitlement rules, (3) KMS/HSM BYOK options and secrets migration steps, (4) marketplace listing copy, embargo timeline, and partner collateral.

Sarah O'Connor: From security: we need to confirm HSM vs managed KMS modes. Nimbus asked for PKCS#11 BYOK and customer-managed KMS — require threat model doc + audit log requirements. Also SCIM must support group filtering for entitlements (no full directory pulls).

Kevin Wu: For SCIM testing, here's a minimal provisioning payload we use in staging:
```json
POST /scim/v2/Users
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "test+nimbus@redwood.ai",
  "name": {"givenName":"Test","familyName":"Nimbus"},
  "emails": [{"value":"test+nimbus@redwood.ai","primary":true}]
}
```
We also require attribute mapping for role -> entitlement and a scoping param for orgUnit/group filters. I'll add examples to the playbook.

Emma L: Timeline: draft playbook by next Tue (3 working days), partner review Wed, joint announcement target two weeks out. Who owns drafts?

Raj Patel: I can own messaging + marketplace copy. @Kevin Wu can take SCIM docs. @Sarah O'Connor takes security checklist and BYOK flow. I will coordinate partner review and embargo window.

integration-bot: Created doc draft at https://docs.internal/redwood/partners/nimbus-playbook (edit perms: Raj, Kevin, Sarah). CI: scim-test-runner queued — will post results.

Kevin Wu: Quick note on secrets migration: recommend staged rollout: (a) export encrypted blobs, (b) import to partner KMS with re-wrapping, (c) rotate tokens and verify consumers. Need step-by-step runbook + rollback instructions for Dedicated customers.

Sarah O'Connor: Add mandatory audit events list: key-wrap, key-unwrap, admin grant, rotation, import/export. Also require SOC2 evidence for Nimbus' HSM provider + encryption-at-rest proof.

Emma L: Great. I'll send a 45m sync invite tomorrow 10:00am PST. Agenda: confirm playbook owners, finish draft checklist items, finalize embargo date and press contacts. :calendar: :eyes:
